fit_reason: Whole SUV listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Dull, hazy black paint on the hood and doors with visible dust and film in the sunlight
Grime and water spotting on the rear liftgate and around the badge
Faded gray lower rear bumper and lower body cladding
Dirty, grayed wheels with brake dust
Scuffs on the rear bumper top surface
Headlights look slightly cloudy in the front three-quarter photo
No interior photos, so the cabin can't be judged
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2009 MDX. The black paint looks a bit hazy in the photos and the gray lower bumper trim has faded, both things a buff and trim restoration would bring back. We do mobile pre-sale details and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
